trigger: real production startup showed two Data workers polling the same sources; one Kraken poll rate_limited
implementation: dedicated PostgreSQL session advisory lock connection owns background collection across rounds and their sleep intervals; competitors skip; cancellation or failure closes the connection; each round checks the connection and has a polling-interval deadline; acquisition SQL deadline 5 seconds; write pool remains separate

automatic_tests.concurrency: contending worker skips without fetching; a later worker acquires after owner connection closes
automatic_tests.cancellation: cancelled collection closes owning connection; next worker can poll
automatic_tests.round_deadline: timeout closes owning connection and a subsequent worker acquires the lock
automatic_tests.between_rounds: background owner retains lock while sleeping; staggered workers do not poll again

review_disposition.dsn_drift: unsupported driver scenario: current supported plain PostgreSQL and postgresql+psycopg normalization is identical to the shared pool; no new SQLAlchemy dependency or driver contract change
review_disposition.round_timeout: overall deadline added in addition to existing provider HTTP deadlines
